lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Good morning everyone. Let's start with the billing export.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Rulo, can you share the status of the billing export?

lines.speaker: W
lines.text: Sure. The export works, and I am testing it with larger files today.

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Luis, did the deploy go through last night?

lines.speaker: P3
lines.text: Yes, it finished at two in the morning without errors.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Rulo, are you blocked on anything?

lines.speaker: W
lines.text: No, I am not blocked. Thanks for asking.

title: Sprint review, a group question and a follow-up

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Okay, let's go through the open items from the sprint.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Who owns the API migration?

lines.speaker: W
lines.text: I can take it. I already know the old endpoints.

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Great. When can you have an estimate?

lines.speaker: W
lines.text: I will send it on Thursday.

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Perfect. We expect general availability in March.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Does anyone have questions about the roadmap?

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Thanks for joining the call. We want to talk about the pricing page.

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Rulo, what is your view on the annual plan?

lines.speaker: W
lines.text: I think the annual plan is a good deal if the discount is clear.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: How much of a discount would feel right?

lines.speaker: W
lines.text: Around twenty percent is common.

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Makes sense. Ana, could you update the slide?

lines.speaker: P3
lines.text: Yes, I will update the slide after the call.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Let's plan the release. The deadline is the end of the month.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Is that realistic for the mobile app?

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: It is tight, but we have done it before.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Rulo, what are the biggest risks you see?

lines.speaker: W
lines.text: The biggest risk is the data migration. We have not tested it with real volumes.

lines.speaker: P3
lines.text: Can we move the migration to the next sprint?

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Let's decide that tomorrow.

title: Design review, the wearer asks too

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: This is the new onboarding flow. It has four steps.

lines.speaker: W
lines.text: Can you explain why the third step is optional?

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Because most users skip it, and we want fewer drop-offs.

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Rulo, do you think four steps is too many?

lines.speaker: W
lines.text: Four is fine if each one is short.

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Okay. And what about the empty state?

lines.speaker: W
lines.text: I would add one sentence and a button.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: I think we should ship smaller changes. That is my main point.

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: I agree. The last release had too many things at once.

lines.speaker: P3
lines.text: We should also write the notes during the sprint, not after it.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Rulo, how did the testing go this sprint?

lines.speaker: W
lines.text: It went well. We found two bugs before the release.

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Good. Let's close the retro here.

title: One on one, a manager and the wearer

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Thanks for making time. How are you feeling about the project?

lines.speaker: W
lines.text: I feel good about it. The scope is clear now.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Do you need anything from me?

lines.speaker: W
lines.text: Maybe some help prioritizing the backlog.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Of course. What would you like to work on next quarter?

lines.speaker: W
lines.text: I would like to lead the search ranking work.

title: Two colleagues talk, the wearer only listens

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Did you see the numbers from the weekend?

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Yes, the signups were higher than expected.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: What do you think caused it?

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: I think the new landing page helped.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Should we run the same test in other countries?

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Let's talk to Rulo about the budget first.

lines.speaker: W
lines.text: I can look at the budget this week.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Buenos días a todos. Empecemos con el avance del proyecto.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Rulo, ¿cómo va la integración con el banco?

lines.speaker: W
lines.text: Va bien. Ya terminé las pruebas con el ambiente de desarrollo.

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: ¿Quién se encarga de la documentación?

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Yo la reviso esta semana.

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Rulo, ¿puedes enviarme el resumen mañana?

lines.speaker: W
lines.text: Claro, te lo envío mañana temprano.

title: Spanish and English in the same meeting

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Let's review the roadmap for the next quarter.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Rulo, ¿cuál es el riesgo principal del release?

lines.speaker: W
lines.text: El riesgo principal es la migración de datos.

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: What is the plan to reduce that risk?

lines.speaker: W
lines.text: We will test with a copy of the real volumes.

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Okay. ¿Alguien más tiene preguntas?

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: No questions from my side.
